description: Original battle creature named Orakyn, a floating owl-mantis oracle. Broad crescent-shaped head, compact dark indigo body, four folded ribbon-like arms, luminous cyan geometric markings, clever severe expression, and a single small crystal hovering above its forehead. Large readable asymmetrical silhouette. Full body in a three-quarter side battle view facing right. Polished 128x128 game pixel art with crisp deliberate pixel clusters, selective dark outline, limited indigo cyan and pale-violet palette, dramatic highlights, transparent background, centered with generous padding. No clothing, no handheld objects, no spoons, no moustache, no human anatomy, no text, no logo, and no resemblance to an existing franchise character.
